referenceEnrichment.policy: Canonical display names, product reference images, and fragrance pyramids are added only where an exact supplier catalog name/SKU matches a researched fragrance. Supplier SKU and original supplier names are preserved. Reference images/notes do not establish supplier-oil equivalence, inventory, or availability.

nameCleanup.method: Cleaned spacing and separators, corrected a controlled set of clear catalog typos, preserved each supplier's original name and SKU, and disambiguated same-name records from different supplier categories rather than deleting them.
nameCleanup.warning: The catalog still requires manual confirmation for ambiguous supplier abbreviations and fragrance variants.
